thinking:
Food delivery service "快送外卖" (Fast Delivery Takeout) in Chengdu.
Students and office workers.
Home page (categories), Restaurant list page, Restaurant detail page (dishes/prices), Order summary page.
Simplified Chinese.

        *   `index.html` (Home)
        *   `restaurants.html` (Restaurant list)
        *   `menu.html` (Restaurant detail)
        *   `checkout.html` (Order summary)
        *   CSS/JS embedded.
        *   No external links/scripts.
        *   No AI references.
        *   Desktop-first (1440px) but responsive.
        *   Real content (no Lorem Ipsum).

    *   *Brand Color Palette:* Warm colors (Orange, Yellow, Red) to stimulate appetite. White and Light Gray backgrounds for a clean, modern look.
    *   *Navigation:* Simple header with logo and links.
    *   *Content for Chengdu:* Mention local specialties (Mapo Tofu, Hotpot, Dan Dan Noodles).

    *   *Page 1: index.html (Home)*
        *   Hero section with a search bar.
        *   Categories: "川味经典" (Sichuan Classics), "快捷快餐" (Fast Food), "精致甜品" (Desserts), "健康轻食" (Healthy Eats).
        *   Featured restaurants section.

    *   *Page 2: restaurants.html (List)*
        *   Filters (Delivery time, Rating, Distance).
        *   Cards: Restaurant Name, Rating, Estimated Time, Categories.
        *   Examples: "成都老味道", "火锅之都", "极速便当".

    *   *Page 3: menu.html (Detail)*
        *   Restaurant Header: Name, Address, Rating.
        *   Menu categories (Main, Side, Drink).
        *   Items: Mapo Tofu (￥22), Kung Pao Chicken (￥25), etc.
        *   "Add to cart" buttons.

    *   *Page 4: checkout.html (Order Summary)*
        *   List of selected items.
        *   Delivery address input.
        *   Payment method selection.
        *   Total calculation.

    *   *CSS:* Flexbox/Grid for layout. Sticky header. Hover effects on cards.
    *   *JS:* Basic interactivity (adding items to cart, navigating). Since it's a static site, I'll use local storage or just simple page transitions to simulate the flow.

    *   *Index:* Welcome to 快送外卖, Chengdu's fastest delivery. Categories: 经典川菜, 奶茶甜点, 商务快餐, 异国风味.
    *   *Restaurants:* "锦江路川味馆" (4.8 stars, 30 mins), "成都火锅王" (4.9 stars, 45 mins), "极速健康餐" (4.5 stars, 20 mins).
    *   *Menu (锦江路川味馆):* 麻婆豆腐 (￥22), 回锅肉 (￥35), 宫保鸡丁 (￥28), 凉拌拍黄瓜 (￥15).
    *   *Checkout:* Order total, Delivery fee (￥3), total.

    *   Simplified Chinese? Yes.
    *   At least 3 pages? Yes (4).
    *   No remote scripts? Yes.
    *   Relative links? Yes.
    *   Desktop 1440px friendly? Yes.
    *   No AI mentions? Yes.
    *   No Lorem Ipsum? Yes.
